description_en: Queries overview information about Microservices Governance
kebab_example: aliyun mse get-overview --period 1 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetOverview

parameters.help_en: The query time. Unit: days. For example, if you set this parameter to 30, the governance rules within the last 30 days are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间。单位：天。比如传入30，说明查询30天内的治理规则情况
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
